svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lid: cut 220 x 140 mm from 3 mm sheet; deburr; round the corners

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to about 1 mm. Four 4.5 mm holes, 7.5 mm in from each end and side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gasket: cut from 1 mm closed-cell EPDM sheet, 220 x 140 mm outside,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 3 mm wide frame (the wall thickness), with a 12 mm round pad at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each corner over the port and a 4.5 mm hole through each pad.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Use the lid as the template for the gasket's four holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: gasket on the top of the tube, lid on the gasket, four M4 x 10

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: button-head screws with bonded sealing washers into the ports.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tighten evenly in a cross pattern until the gasket is squeezed

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to about two-thirds of its thickness; do not crush it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lid sits flat; no gap you can see round the edge.
